producer_contract_assessment.rationale: producer.py writes UTF-8 JSON Lines with one complete event object per line in order (C3). It serializes the datetime timestamp using json.dumps with default=str, which calls datetime.__str__ producing ISO 8601 format with a 'T' separator and no space (C2). All declared UserEvent fields are present and public function names and signatures are unchanged (C1).

recipient_integration_plan.rationale: processor.py violates C4 by writing output with encoding='latin-1' instead of UTF-8. It violates C5 by wrapping each processed event in an envelope dict {'data': processed} instead of writing bare event objects at the top level; the sink expects direct access to fields like event_id and timestamp. These defects must be fixed in processor.py to meet its public responsibilities when paired with a conforming producer.
